title: feat(search): add fzf-style fuzzy subsequence matching
body:
## Summary / 摘要

Add a zero-dependency, fzf-style fuzzy (subsequence) matcher to `@floatboat/nexus-plugin-search`, exposed both as a standalone `fuzzyMatch()` utility and via a non-breaking `fuzzy` option on existing search utilities. Lands roadmap item #17.

## Motivation / 背景与动机

- Issue: N/A
- Roadmap (docs/ROADMAP.md): #17 Fuzzy search (`plugin-search`, P2, status: `done`). Requirement: *"Evaluate fzf-like algorithm vs. third-party lib; needs backtracking matcher."*
- OpenSpec change: N/A (roadmap marks #17 as "No OpenSpec"; non-breaking additive option).

The search plugin already ships literal, whole-word, and regex matching. Fuzzy/subsequence matching is a key feature for editor-level searching. The roadmap explicitly calls for a **backtracking matcher** rather than a greedy left-to-right scan to avoid low-scoring alignments.

## Changes / 变更内容

- `packages/plugin-search`:
  - Added zero-dependency `fuzzyMatch(text, query, options)` implementing an O(n·m) DP algorithm with backtracking for optimal subsequence alignment (rewards contiguous runs `+16`, word-start/CJK boundaries `+8`, exact-case matches `+4`, and penalizes gaps `-1`).
  - Added `FuzzyMatch` & `FuzzyMatchOptions` exported types.
  - Added `fuzzy?: boolean` option to `SearchOptions` and integrated into `findSearchMatches(doc, query, { fuzzy: true })`.
  - Handled CRLF (`\r\n`) line endings in `findFuzzyLineMatches` to ensure clean text extraction while preserving CodeMirror document offsets.
  - Made `replaceAllMatches(..., { fuzzy: true })` return the original document without changes for safety.
- `docs/ROADMAP.md` & `docs/ROADMAP.zh.md`:
  - Marked Roadmap item #17 as `done`.
- `apps/electron-demo`:
  - Added a styled 'Fuzzy' toggle button to the demo search bar UI.

## Testing / 测试

- [x] `pnpm test` passes / 全绿 (53/53 tests passed)
- [x] Affected packages build (`pnpm build`) / 受影响包构建通过
- [x] New / updated vitest cases / 新增或更新的 vitest 用例：19 new unit tests in `packages/plugin-search/test/plugin-search.test.ts` covering subsequence hits, DP scoring order, CJK boundaries, non-contiguous replace safety, and CRLF offsets.
- [x] Manual UI check in electron-demo / electron-demo 手动验证：Verified Fuzzy search toggle in search bar UI

## Compliance / 合规自检

- [x] **CLA signed** — first-time contributors will be prompted automatically by the CLA bot
- [x] **AI disclosure**: AI assistance was used for drafting test cases, edge-case analysis, and PR documentation. Code implementation and design choices (O(n·m) DP, CJK word-start scoring, CRLF offset handling) were reviewed and verified line-by-line.
- [x] **New dependencies**: none
- [x] **No build artifacts** committed (`dist/`, `dist-electron/`, compiled `.js` from `.ts`)
- [x] **No secrets** / `.env` / personal vault data committed

## Checklist / 自检清单

- [x] Title follows Conventional Commits
- [x] Public API changes update package README / types — exported types `FuzzyMatch`, `FuzzyMatchOptions` and `SearchOptions.fuzzy`
- [x] Touched `live-preview-table.ts` → N/A
- [x] New capability / breaking change → OpenSpec proposal linked → N/A (Roadmap #17 marks "No OpenSpec")
- [x] Change aligns with project scope (GOVERNANCE.md §4)
